description: Score how ready a website is for AI agents, 0-100: llms.txt, sitemap, OpenAPI spec, MCP server card, A2A agent card and x402 payment discovery, each found or missing with its URL, which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others) robots.txt lets in, and a list of fixes. Reads only the public files a site publishes; nothing is signed in or submitted. Use to audit your own site or vet a service before an agent relies on it. Example: url=https://stripe.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

url.description: The site: a domain or any URL on it (its origin is checked)

name: agent_readiness
title: Agent readiness, llms.txt check
